$comment: Every talent build code the repo stores or documents, by class: the spec defaults and presets (src/sim/defaults.ts), the class docs' builds (warrior.md §6.1, druid.md §7.1, paladin.md), a popular Restoration build and the codes in tests. Share links and saved setups store build codes, so a code must keep meaning the same build: `ranks` lists, per tree, the ranks by talent name the code decoded to when it was written ('Name rank, Name rank'; '' for an empty tree). Hand-authored scraper input, the one source of truth for stored codes: scripts/scrape/talents-client.mjs refuses to write a dataset under which a code decodes to other ranks, and src/data/data.test.ts checks the committed datasets against it (docs/data/talents.md#build-codes-verified). If a doc changes a build, change it here too. The class sections are codes on today's trees; `legacy` keeps the codes stored when the trees were an older build's, frozen.
